mappings.note: The 18th-century Armenian College and Mother Mary Church in Kolkata. A settled community's institutions; goal-level CG-SST2, and LO-80 is not cited because the buildings are named as landmarks, not described.
A copper-plate land grant to shipwrecked newcomers, resolved to the Jewish community at Kochi. Reading a document to identify a community's history, goal-level CG-SST2.

Parsis adopting Indian dress and custom while keeping their faith and fire temples, against the false claim of conversion. CG-SST2 for the integration, LO-80 for the fire temple as a maintained place of worship. (Stem survives only as its last line; see report.)
Why India became a sanctuary for Jewish communities - rulers granting free land and religious freedom. CG-SST2 for the migration history, LO-83 for the equal standing extended to a minority.
Vivekananda's 1893 Chicago speech and India's reputation for shelter. LO-83 for the claim of equal welcome, CG-SST2 for the speech as a historical moment.
Parsi assimilation after the flight from Persia, told through the sugar-and-milk legend and their living fire tradition. Migration and integration, goal-level CG-SST2.
Zoroastrian and Vedic traditions sharing cosmic order, fire ritual, and Old Avestan-Vedic Sanskrit grammar. CG-SST2 for the linguistic evidence, LO-81 for the religious kinship of two traditions.
Arab spice merchants settling peacefully on the west coast, marrying locally and forming the Mappila community. Migration and integration, goal-level CG-SST2; LO-80 is reserved for the mosque items.

Siddi fusion - African drumming and dance held alongside Indian languages and faiths. Cultural integration, goal-level CG-SST2; LO-84 is reserved for the scheduled-tribe item, which is about economic standing.
Armenians under Akbar's patronage rising in administration and the army, then building schools and churches in Kolkata and Chennai. A community's role and legacy, goal-level CG-SST2.
Synagogue as the Jewish place of worship. LO-80, the frame's only outcome reaching places of worship.
Dates Vivekananda's Chicago speech to 1893. Historical chronology, goal-level CG-SST2; the value-content items carry LO-83 instead.
Syriac as the language of Kerala's early Christian immigrants. Linguistic evidence of origin, goal-level CG-SST2.
The Malabar coast as where Syriac Christians settled. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
Ahura Mazda as the Zoroastrian supreme God. A religious tradition's core belief, LO-81.
Persia, now Iran, as the Parsis' country of origin. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
Raja Jadi Rana as the king of Sanjan who took the Parsis in. Historical act of refuge, goal-level CG-SST2.
Udvada as the seat of the Parsi sacred fire. A place of worship, LO-80.
The Avesta as the Parsi scripture. A religious tradition's text, LO-81; the Avestan-Sanskrit items carry CG-SST2 because there the point is linguistic.
Cheraman Juma Masjid as India's oldest mosque. LO-80 names mosques explicitly.
Africa as the Siddis' origin. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.

Hirabai Lobi's Padma Shri in 2023 for work among Siddi women. CG-SST4 for recognising a section of society's contribution, LO-84 because that work addresses the community's economic and social disadvantage.
Akbar's reign as when Armenians settled in Agra. Historical chronology, goal-level CG-SST2.
Kolkata as the city of the Armenian College and Mother Mary Church. A community's footprint, goal-level CG-SST2.
Baha'u'llah as founder of the Baha'i faith. Emergence of a religious movement, LO-81.
New Delhi as the site of the Lotus Temple. A place of worship, LO-80.
Digvijaysinhji Ranjitsinhji Jadeja as the Maharaja who took in the Polish orphans. Historical fact, goal-level CG-SST2.
Good Maharaja Square in Warsaw. A memorial and what it commemorates, goal-level CG-SST2.
1959 as the year the 14th Dalai Lama reached India. Chronology of a migration, goal-level CG-SST2.

Match-list of Vivekananda, Jadi Rana, Digvijaysinhji and Hirabai Lobi against what each did. CG-SST2 for the historical acts, LO-83 because the through-line is shelter and standing extended to outsiders and the disadvantaged. (Fragmentary stem; see report.)

Match-list of Kochi's synagogue, Udvada's fire, Dharamshala's Tibetan administration and the Cheraman Juma Masjid. LO-80 for the three places of worship, CG-SST2 for Dharamshala as a refugee seat. (Fragmentary stem; see report.)
Vasudhaiva kutumbakam translated. LO-83 as the nearest outcome for a value of inclusion.
The Kingdom of Israel as the Bene Israel's origin. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
The Konkan coast as the Bene Israel's settlement. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.

Mapped on its stem, which asks who granted the Kerala Jews land free of cost - the Raja of Kochi. Historical act of refuge, goal-level CG-SST2. (The stored answer is a watermark line plus text about Armenian court service; see report.)
Baha'is branded heretics in Iran for beliefs at odds with orthodoxy. Emergence of a religious movement and the resistance to it, LO-81.
Why Baha'is revere India - safety on arrival and room for a faith open to all backgrounds. LO-83 for the equal welcome, LO-81 for the religious movement it allowed to grow.
How Digvijaysinhji helped - rescuing about a thousand orphans and feeding and housing them. Historical act, goal-level CG-SST2.
Why Poland built the Warsaw monument. Commemoration of a historical act, goal-level CG-SST2.
Monks carrying Sanskrit manuscripts to Tibet after Nalanda's destruction. CG-SST2 for the flight and the texts saved, LO-81 for the Buddhist tradition transplanted with them.
The 1959 Lhasa uprising forcing the Dalai Lama across the Himalaya. Historical event, goal-level CG-SST2.
Indian government asylum, rehabilitation, schooling and settlements for Tibetan refugees. CG-SST4 for government acting as an institution, LO-83 for the equal footing those measures created.
The Dalai Lama's Four Commitments - human values, religious harmony, Tibetan culture, India's civilisational heritage. LO-83 for the universal values, LO-81 for harmony between religious traditions.
Atithi devo bhava and the duty of hospitality. LO-83 as the nearest outcome for a value of welcome.

India's coastlines and mountains shaping who arrived and how. CG-SST1 for geography as a cause, CG-SST2 for the migrations it produced; LO-74 is rejected because the argument is about access, not climate.
Indian expatriates abroad as peaceful, integrating and economically contributing. Contribution of a section of society, goal-level CG-SST4.

This row's stem is a question and its answer run together, both about Sowa Rigpa as a Tibetan medical system used in India. A knowledge tradition carried by refugees, goal-level CG-SST2. (Merged stem, and the stored answer belongs to the Baha'i question; see report.)
Digvijaysinhji's wartime rescue, shelter, food and schooling for Polish orphans. CG-SST2 for the event, LO-83 for the principle of care extended without regard to origin.

The annexation of Tibet and the 1959 uprising leading to asylum at Dharamshala and the Central Tibetan Administration. Historical causation, goal-level CG-SST2; LO-86 is rejected outright, being local versus State government in India.
India enabling Tibetan schools, settlements and monasteries. CG-SST4 for the state's role, LO-83 for a minority's freedom to keep its own culture.

Sowa Rigpa's recognition within AYUSH. CG-SST4 for the government framework that admitted it, CG-SST2 for the tradition's origins and blending; this pair is what distinguishes it from the bare 'what is Sowa Rigpa' items.
Vasudhaiva kutumbakam as the ethos behind India's treatment of refugees over time. LO-83 for the value, CG-SST2 for the historical record it is said to explain.
The Karaniya Metta Sutta read against the chapter's values of inclusivity and shelter. LO-83 for the value, LO-81 for the religious teaching it comes from.
How expatriates carry Indian values abroad - law-abiding, integrating, contributing. Contribution of a section of society, goal-level CG-SST4.

This row's stem is a question and its answer run together; the scored content is what its own answer gives - Dharamshala in Himachal Pradesh as the Tibetan seat in exile. Refugee settlement, goal-level CG-SST2. (Merged stem; see report.)
Sowa Rigpa as the Tibetan system of medicine. A knowledge tradition, goal-level CG-SST2.
Why Jewish communities came to India - escaping persecution in successive waves. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
The Bene Israel shipwrecked on the Konkan coast. Migration history, goal-level CG-SST2.
The Raja of Kochi granting land in perpetuity so a synagogue could be built. CG-SST2 for the grant, LO-83 for the standing it gave a minority faith.

Syriac Christians persecuted in Persia on suspicion of siding with Rome. A political, not doctrinal, cause, so goal-level CG-SST2 here, where the Roman-persecution item carries LO-81 for its theological cause.
